note: encoder.pt is NOT used — the speaker encoder's pretrained weights come from the resemblyzer package instead. Only synthesizer.pt and vocoder.pt are required. The audioseal/* entries are the inaudible-watermark networks (SPEECH_QUALITY_PLAN.md S7.2b), fetched from facebook/audioseal into <WEIGHTS_DIR>/audioseal/.
